name: ojo
description: Connect local websites and apps to OJO for design optimization. Check project compatibility, prepare and validate prototypes, sync project files, and request design improvement proposals.

interface.longDescription: OJO helps developers and product teams improve the design of existing websites and apps. Check a local project's compatibility, prepare it for the OJO workflow, sync an OJO project's files, and validate prototypes and page states. Request design improvement proposals, review OJO's response, and approve changes before execution. Upload validated content to a project you select. Requires local execution, Node.js 20 or later, and a compatible OJO CLI. Remote features require an OJO account with access to the selected project. Local canvas preview is currently unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Check this local website's compatibility with OJO and explain the preparation steps.
Ask OJO for design improvements to my project. Show me the proposal and wait for approval before making changes.
Sync my OJO project's files and validate the prototype build and page state snapshots.
